source_row.english: Stealing is to take possession of another's wealth, purposely and without a mistake, whether it be by means of superior force or by stealth--undetected. Sexual misconduct is engaging in kinds of sex which are improper to perform, purposely and with no mistaken identity.

spans.rationale: Established stealing compound with exact glossary stealing. Its internal negative and taking elements are lexicalized, not separately nulled.
First intentionality compound belongs to the stealing definition. Exact glossary purposely, distinct from the later sexual-conduct condition.
First error negation owns without; exclude a.
First NOR is the mistake sense in the stealing definition, distinct from wealth and the later mistaken adjective.
Other/another identifies the owner of the property. The possessive clitic remains outside; the unrelated mined a bodhisattva sense is not promoted.
Second NOR is the wealth sense, exactly glossary-attested.
Power/force noun owns force. The additional source DBANG CHA contributes coercive power but does not license a secure isolated superior atom.
Coordinator joins force and stealth. The anchor begins at the actual coordinator, avoiding the letters or inside force.
Whole inflected stealth word; agentive s stays attached and is not a separate source token.

Complete non-detection expression is rendered undetected. The negative phrase is kept whole, with no positive detected interior cut or invented null. Complete TSHOR evidence and C01:193/C16:89 support the noticing/knowing sense.
Established ownership expression has exact glossary possession. Exclude the following object relation of.
Action verb has exact glossary take and supplies the light verb in take possession. Exclude is to.
Second intentionality compound belongs to sexual misconduct. It does not reuse the first purposely target.
Second error negation owns no. With is the English condition frame and remains outside.
Third NOR is the error sense with adjectival English inflection. Identity is contextual specification and stays outside this narrow claim.

spans.rationale: The complete negative eligibility/action expression is recast as improper to perform. This genuine phrase preserves negation plus what is to be done; it does not invent a bgrod/proper atom.
Whole inflected going/engaging verb belongs to the sexual-act definition. The unrelated mined misery gloss is rejected without modification.
Established sexual-misconduct compound in its exact inflected PAR form. Exclude the following is; no synthetic source PA is substituted.

omissions.tib: ni; du; bar/par around condition words; gyi; bound agentive s and declarative o
omissions.reason: Topic, adverbial, possessive and declarative grammar is distributed across the English definitions. Preserve inflected source words intact. No fifth subword convention or absent-meaning null is introduced.

Complete DBANG/CHA records support power and part/aspect, but do not independently isolate superior in this local coercive-force expression. Keep MTHU/force and leave this modifier relation uncertain.

Desire, means and becoming are compressed into the English definition of engaging in kinds of sex. Neither desire/sex nor becoming/the copula is individually secured by the local recast. These remain unbanked, with no claim that their meaning is absent.

The explicit four-types tail is rendered at the start of English352, which begins This sexual misconduct is of four different types. English351 kinds of sex occurs within the engagement definition and is not a safe replacement for that fourfold enumeration. Cross-segment distribution is preserved without a false null or a source correction.
